_comment: These rows are NOT created here. CodeGen creates one EntityRelationship per foreign key, so all
five Deal -> child relationships already exist by the time this directory is pushed; what this
directory does is fill in ONE column on three of them -- `RelatedRecordCollection`, the JSON that
turns a plain relationship into a typed, writable child collection on the parent entity.
autoCreateMissingRecords is FALSE, deliberately overriding the repo-root default. Every record
here resolves its primary key with @lookup against Entity + RelatedEntity, and the CodeGen row it
targets is re-minted with a NEW ID on every rebuild-db -- which is exactly why the lookup is by
name rather than by a hardcoded UUID. If a lookup ever fails to resolve, the correct outcome is a
LOUD FAILURE. With auto-create on, the push would instead insert a SECOND, half-populated
EntityRelationship beside CodeGen's, and the collection would appear to work while the duplicate
quietly broke the next codegen run.
